rules.title: Hoboken ban on algorithmic rent coordination
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.key_value: ban on software/algorithms/data-sharing platforms coordinating rents, lease terms or occupancy
rules.citation: Hoboken City Code ch. 158, Art. II
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits landlords from using software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy
rules.effective_date_note: Law-firm alert says 'effective July 2025'; exact day not given.
rules.conflict_note: NJ FAIR Act (P.L.2026, c.43) may preempt this ordinance once it takes effect; not discussed in the source document.
rules.review_note: Only a secondary law-firm summary is available; the ordinance text (ecode360 links D032-D034) was not captured.

parsed.notes: Merged duplicate candidates c83 and c90 (same source text in D002 and D037). The documents give no Hoboken-level rules or findings for the other categories. The ecode360 sources (D032-D034) are link-only, so no unverified rules were added.
